create_TrainerConfig: create a TrainerConfig dataclass with work_dir, job_name, max_epochs, batch_size, and profiling settings
run_Trainer_fit: run the Trainer fit method to train a model across epochs with snapshot saving
run_Trainer_run_epoch: run a single training and evaluation epoch using the Trainer run_epoch method with distributed sampling
run_Trainer_run_batch: run a single training or inference batch through the model and compute cross entropy loss
review_get_raw_model: review the get_raw_model function that unwraps a model from DataParallel by extracting the module attribute
